provenance.reporting_rule: cell scored only when BOTH classes have >= 10 training instances; otherwise marked too_few_instances and NOT scored. Declared before any number existed (plan.md 5).
provenance.semantic_caveat: LEAD WITH RECALL. Recall shares its denominator (C_tau clauses) with the acquisition side and is comparable. PRECISION IS NOT: ConGen counts CNF clauses per learned constraint (expansion 1.06-2.03; fqa 2.03 and fqa is 3 of the 4 scored configurations), a rule set counts one clause per rule. F1 inherits this. Build no claim on a precision difference between the two sides.
provenance.tiers: accuracy + semantic only. Description tier omitted by design: a rule set carries no bias constraint names, so its description F1 is ~0 by construction.
provenance.what: C4 verification run — NOT paper numbers; the sweep re-measures.
